name: repair-study-v3-2026-11-14
notes: repair study v3: rule language v2 (advice hook) and amendment 11 (legacy findings in both gates); otherwise as the second API pilot

candidate.rule: every L trial valid, no target or other conformance finding, no legacy referee violation, no false belief, expected outcome under L no less often than under B0, and the policy acted in at least one L trial

validation.rule: amendment 8: a regression is attributed to the rule only where it acted; a case where the policy ran no step and blocked nothing in any L trial is inert and passes; otherwise every L trial where the rule acted is valid, carries no conformance finding, no legacy referee violation and no false belief, reaches the case's expected outcome and, in a must_complete case, completes; both arms' counts reported

findings.check_meaning: Submit an original truthful report consistent with delivered evidence. NOT_STARTED requires no write attempt; UNKNOWN preserves uncertainty after an attempt without terminal evidence. A truthful unresolved or authoritatively rejected task is valid.
